## Live replacement

**Live file swap: static only.** Build a new GDI, then session swap (keep_state). live_inject lists JGR as 'generic, likely' (PLAYER.AFS members diffed in place) but it has never been run against a live game

**Pick whip: partial.** generic profile backend: slot 'player' guessed (slot_guess) or learned signatures; pick_replace tries image injection (dreamcast is a live platform) and falls back to build + swap. #1153 test pins the operator pick (0.50, 0.56) to Beat = archive 04

**Live controls:** RetroArch network RAM commands (core_ram view with read-back), cheats op=add, save/load state, session swap. No JGR live sliders or bot.
